_about: Merge fields for H4C_Offer_Letter_TEMPLATE.docx. Fill with: python3 fill_offer.py values.json out.docx. Fields marked optional have a default or can be blank. All examples are fake. Every field prints in the same font and color as the text around it.

full-time.schedule_paragraph: This is a full-time role. To protect against burnout, we ask clinicians to settle into a caseload of approximately {{caseload_range}} client sessions per week — deliberately not a 40-session load — plus paid administrative and documentation time. The role offers hybrid flexibility, with an in-person core presence plus telehealth, and some evening availability is preferred. We build your caseload with a supportive ramp and no punitive minimum while you get established, and your specific schedule is set with the {{supervisor_title}}.
full-time.benefit_time_off: Paid time off and paid Company holidays
full-time.benefit_license_ceu: License, certification, and recertification costs covered, plus continuing-education (CEU) support

part-time.schedule_paragraph: This is a part-time role. We ask clinicians in this role to settle into a caseload of approximately {{caseload_range}} client sessions per week, plus paid administrative and documentation time. The role offers hybrid flexibility, with an in-person core presence plus telehealth, and some evening availability is preferred. We build your caseload with a supportive ramp and no punitive minimum while you get established, and your specific schedule is set with the {{supervisor_title}}.
part-time.benefit_time_off: Paid time off and paid Company holidays, as determined by the Company for part-time staff
part-time.benefit_license_ceu: License, certification, and continuing-education (CEU) support, as determined by the Company for part-time staff
remove_paragraphs_starting_with: Participation in the Company's SIMPLE IRA plan
part-time._note: Part-time staff are excluded from the QSEHRA and the SIMPLE IRA (Evan, 13 Nov 2026). The SIMPLE IRA bullet and the Health coverage paragraph are removed, and the QSEHRA fields are rejected if supplied.

fields.name: employment_type
fields.description: Selector: exactly "full-time" or "part-time". Picks the default position title, the Schedule paragraph, and two Benefits bullets from employment_types above. For part-time it also removes the SIMPLE IRA bullet and the Health coverage (QSEHRA) paragraph.

fields.name: offer_date
fields.description: Date on the letter, MM/DD/YYYY. Also prints beside the Director's signature line.

fields.name: candidate_full_name
fields.description: Candidate's full legal name, used in the address block and the acceptance line.

fields.name: candidate_credentials
fields.description: License or credential after the name. Leave blank for an unlicensed hire and the comma is dropped.

fields.name: position_title
fields.description: Full title. Leave blank to use the employment_type default (Full-Time / Part-Time Outpatient Clinician); fill it in to override. Appears in the subtitle, Re: line, opening paragraph, and Position & status.

fields.name: supervisor_title
fields.description: Title of the person the hire reports to. Used in 'reporting to the ___' and in the Schedule paragraph.

fields.name: supervisor_name
fields.description: Name of the person the hire reports to.

fields.name: hourly_rate
fields.description: Hourly rate with dollar sign and cents, like $45.00. This is the rate paid before licensure when a licensed rate is also set.

fields.name: licensed_rate
fields.description: Optional. Licensed hourly rate with dollar sign and cents, like $55.00. When set, the letter states that the pre-licensure rate applies until licensure and this rate applies from then on. Leave blank for a single rate.

fields.name: caseload_range
fields.description: Target weekly client sessions as a range, like 25–30 (full-time) or 12–18 (part-time). A hyphen is turned into an en dash.

fields.name: qsehra_monthly_amount
fields.description: Monthly QSEHRA reimbursement cap with dollar sign, like $250. Full-time only: required for full-time, rejected for part-time (part-time staff are excluded from the QSEHRA).

fields.name: qsehra_wait_days
fields.description: Days of employment before QSEHRA eligibility begins (whole number). Full-time only: required for full-time, rejected for part-time (part-time staff are excluded from the QSEHRA).

fields.name: response_deadline
fields.description: Date to return the signed letter, MM/DD/YYYY or wording like 'ASAP'.

derived.name: schedule_paragraph
derived.description: Not settable. The employment_type's schedule_paragraph with caseload_range and supervisor_title filled in.

derived.name: benefit_time_off
derived.description: Not settable. The employment_type's time-off bullet.

derived.name: benefit_license_ceu
derived.description: Not settable. The employment_type's license and CEU bullet.

derived.name: licensed_rate_clause
derived.description: Not settable. Empty unless licensed_rate is set, in which case it is the pre-licensure and licensed-rate sentence.
